ns2:course.label: International Trade Policy
ns2:course.description: Analysis of the regulation of trade between nations by international agreement (e.g., the GATT), by multinational organizations (e.g., the European Communities), and by individual countries; emphasizes U.S. import restraints, export controls, and related laws. 3 professional hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Law department.
